job: Let someone scan a code with a phone to pair a device or add an authenticator.
purpose: A QR code figure that keeps a light surface in dark mode, because cameras read dark on light. Draw it with currentColor or use an img. Sizes: sm 160px, default 240px, lg 320px; it never grows past its container. Always show the same value as text beside it.
useWhen: Pairing a phone or device with an account.
Adding an authenticator app during two-factor setup.
Handing a link from a desktop screen to a phone.

avoidWhen.when: The reader is already on the phone that needs the link.
A key or token to copy.
A short value to copy beside the code.

variants.useWhen: 320px, when the code must scan from a distance.

parts.role: The figure; give it an aria-label that says what the code is for.
